definitions.short: the weeping tree (some gum-distilling tree, perhaps the balsam)
definitions.full: H1057. baka בָּכָא noun [masculine] balsam-tree (see Arabic Dozy ZMG 1869, 188 but Löw No. 47 ; according to TA like , an eruca , compare Lane under the word; perhaps compare give little milk , of camel, i.e. drop, drip ); plural בְּכָאִים 2Sam 5:23-24 , = 1Chr 14:14-15 , singular in הַבָּכָא עֵמֶק Psa 84:7 balsam-vale , compare De Che.
